events.title: Emperor Augustus dies at Nola
events.description: Augustus, Rome's first emperor, died aged 75 after more than four decades in power. His stepson Tiberius succeeded him, confirming the hereditary principle of the Julio-Claudian dynasty.
events.html: Augustus, Rome's first emperor, died aged 75 after more than four decades in power. His stepson Tiberius succeeded him, confirming the hereditary principle of the Julio-Claudian dynasty.

events.title: Mary, Queen of Scots returns to Scotland
events.description: Widowed by Francis II of France, Mary landed at Leith after 13 years in France. She returned as a Catholic queen to a kingdom that had just adopted the Protestant Reformation.
events.html: Widowed by Francis II of France, Mary landed at Leith after 13 years in France. She returned as a Catholic queen to a kingdom that had just adopted the Protestant Reformation.

events.title: USS Constitution defeats HMS Guerriere
events.description: The American frigate Constitution dismasted and captured HMS Guerriere off Nova Scotia. Seeing shot rebound from her oak hull, sailors nicknamed her 'Old Ironsides'.
events.html: The American frigate Constitution dismasted and captured HMS Guerriere off Nova Scotia. Seeing shot rebound from her oak hull, sailors nicknamed her 'Old Ironsides'.

events.title: Coup backed by the CIA and MI6 topples Iran's Mosaddegh
events.description: Army units and paid crowds overthrew Prime Minister Mohammad Mosaddegh, who had nationalised Iran's oil industry. The Shah's power was restored, and resentment of foreign meddling fed the 1979 revolution.

events.title: Soviet hardliners launch a coup against Gorbachev
events.description: Communist hardliners placed Mikhail Gorbachev under house arrest in Crimea and declared a state of emergency. Boris Yeltsin led resistance in Moscow, the coup collapsed, and the USSR dissolved by December.

intl.name: World Humanitarian Day
intl.description: Established by the UN General Assembly to mark the 2003 Baghdad bombing that killed 22 aid workers, World Humanitarian Day pays tribute to humanitarian workers killed or injured in the line of duty and calls for the protection of civilians in conflict.
